import parse

# Test left/center alignment with whitespace
tests = [
    ("{:<}", "hello   world"),
    ("{:^}", " hello "),
    ("{:5}", "hello world"),  # Right align - should still work
    ("{:>5}", "hello world"),  # Explicit right align
    ("{:<10}", "hello"),  # Left align with width
    ("{:^10}", "hello"),  # Center align with width
]

for pattern, string in tests:
    p = parse.compile(pattern)
    print(f"Pattern {pattern!r}: expr={p._expression!r}")
    
    r_search = p.search(string)
    print(f"  search({string!r}): {r_search}")
    
    r_parse = p.parse(string)
    print(f"  parse({string!r}): {r_parse}")
    print()
PYEOF
